arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/stress.py <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource
routes = {}
labels = ['o%d' % i for i in range(16)]
for i in range(64):
    routes['https://h%d.test' % i] = labels[i % 16]
events = []
body = 'ab' * 32768   # 65536 bytes -> 128KiB hex
for i in range(256):
    sid = i * 4
    events.append({'sid':sid,'type':'headers','fields':[[':method','POST'],[':scheme','https'],
        [':authority','h%d.test' % (i % 64)],[':path','/p/%d' % i],['x-list-a','v'*100],
        ['content-length','65536']]})
    events.append({'sid':sid,'type':'data','hex':body})
    events.append({'sid':sid,'type':'unknown','frame_type':33,'hex':'aa'})
    events.append({'sid':sid,'type':'fin'})
raw = json.dumps({'routes':routes,'events':events}).encode()
print("input bytes", len(raw))
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/submission/bridge.py'], input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print("rc", p.returncode, "time", round(time.time()-t0,2))
usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print("max child RSS MB", usage.ru_maxrss/1024)
r = json.loads(p.stdout)
print("streams", len(r['streams']), "forwarded", sum(1 for s in r['streams'] if s['status']=='forwarded'))
print("origins", len(r['origins']), "total pipeline bytes", sum(len(v)//2 for v in r['origins'].values()))
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/stress.py
